# Vortex Gaming

> > Vortex Gaming is a Web3-powered integrated gamer community platform featuring VRTX/VOR tokens, fan rewards, and DAO governance on Near MainNet.

Vortex Gaming connects content creators and gaming communities through blockchain technology, enabling tokenized rewards and decentralized governance. The platform is operated by Vortex Protocol Pte. Ltd. and leverages the Near blockchain ecosystem.
